Nitu Kumar Patra
📧 nitupatra@yahoo.co.uk • 📞 +91-6901362045 • 📍 Bangalore, India
LinkedIn Profile | Github | IntelliFlowAI

🌟 Professional Summary
Results-driven Lead Software Engineer with over 18 years of experience in designing scalable, high-performance applications. Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and cloud-native architectures (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker). Proficient in full-stack development, AI-driven solutions, and DevOps. Proven leadership in optimizing performance and driving innovation in enterprise software. Passionate about AI, machine learning, and emerging technologies.

⚖️ Core Competencies

Languages: Java (1.6–1.8), JavaScript, Python

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Hibernate, Microservices, RESTful APIs

Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Frontend: React.js, AngularJS, Tailwind CSS, Vite

Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop, Apache Hive

Security: OAuth, Okta, JWT Authentication

AI/ML: LLMs, NLP, AI-driven automation

Practices: Agile, Scrum, TDD, Design Patterns

💼 Professional Experience

Principal Member Technical Staff
Oracle India Pvt Ltd, Bangalore | Aug 2021 – Mar 2025

Architected and optimized Oracle Fusion Applications using Oracle ADF and Spring Boot, ensuring modularity and maintainability.

Designed and deployed microservices architectures with REST APIs, enabling seamless integration across enterprise systems.

Implemented performance tuning strategies (caching, connection pooling, async processing) that reduced latency and improved throughput.

Enhanced scalability and resilience with load balancing, horizontal scaling, and fault-tolerant service design.

Led middleware integration and backend processing, resolving complex distributed system issues under tight SLAs.

Improved monitoring & observability with logging, tracing, and metrics, enabling proactive issue detection and faster root-cause analysis.

Senior Software Engineer
Sirius Embedded Software Pvt Ltd, Bangalore | Oct 2018 – Aug 2021

Led migration from monolithic to microservices architecture, driving design decisions and mentoring engineers.

Developed cloud-based microservices for secure OTA (Over-the-Air) automotive updates using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and open-source Java frameworks.

Integrated authentication & authorization with Okta and JWT for secure access management.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes) for automated build, test, and deployment.

Built real-time data pipelines with PostgreSQL + AWS Lambda, reducing processing latency by 40%.

Delivered scalable, fault-tolerant solutions in cross-functional Agile teams, improving time-to-market.

Software Consultant
Infogain Corporation, Bangalore | Nov 2014 – Aug 2018

Engineered big data pipelines using Hadoop, MapReduce, and Hive to process terabytes of enterprise data.

Designed and implemented ETL workflows (data ingestion, cleansing, transformation) from diverse sources like Oracle DB and APIs.

Automated data quality checks to ensure consistency and reliability for downstream consumption.

Performed EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) with statistical methods and visualization to uncover trends and anomalies.

Created probabilistic algorithms for efficient data retrieval, improving query performance.

Led a team in delivering high-performance enterprise solutions, optimizing scalability and maintainability.

Previous Roles (2007 – 2014)

Held various development and leadership roles across network management and cloud-based systems.

Delivered scalable, enterprise-grade applications with significant client impact.

💡 Projects & Open Source

Customer Service Microservice (CRM Application) | Jan 2023 – Mar 2025

Designed and developed the Customer Service microservice as part of a large-scale CRM microservices architecture (Accounts, Leads, Opportunities, Campaigns, Notifications, Analytics).

Implemented RESTful APIs for service request creation, SLA tracking, and escalations; integrated with Accounts and Notification services for seamless customer experience.

Architected and deployed an AI-powered chatbot using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with Oracle-developed LLM to automate customer support:

Configured retriever pipeline with vector database for FAQs, historical tickets, and policy documents.

Instructed the LLM to respond only to business-context queries, with a refinement layer to validate and reformat responses before showing to users.

Integrated with Customer Service APIs to auto-create/update tickets when bot confidence was low or escalation was required.

Ensured data security and compliance by implementing JWT authentication, anonymizing sensitive customer data, and encrypting data at rest.

Optimized performance by caching frequent queries, reducing average bot response time by 50%.

Implemented logging, monitoring (ELK, Prometheus), and fallback mechanisms to ensure system reliability and traceability.

Impact: Automated ~40% of repetitive queries, reduced average response time by 60%, and freed agents to focus on complex issues — significantly improving customer satisfaction and efficiency.

Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Oracle LLM, RAG, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate/Oracle equivalent), JWT, Docker, ELK Stack, Prometheus.

Voice-Powered RAG Agent System | 2025 – Present

Designed and implemented a voice-interactive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system integrating Whisper ASR, LangChain, and vector databases (FAISS/Chroma) for real-time query resolution.

Enabled conversational search across enterprise and research documents, providing users with instant, context-aware responses and improving information accessibility.

Built a pipeline for audio-to-text processing, semantic search, and LLM-driven answer generation, optimizing for low-latency real-time interaction.

Developed mechanisms for query contextualization, retrieval ranking, and result summarization, enhancing accuracy and user experience.

Designed the system to be scalable and modular, allowing seamless integration with other enterprise knowledge management systems.

Creative Writing Agents (LLM Orchestration) | 2025 – Present

Developed autonomous writing agents orchestrated via LangGraph, capable of generating stories, scripts, and structured content with minimal human supervision.

Designed modular pipelines for character-driven storytelling, enabling dynamic plot generation, dialogue creation, and thematic consistency.

Open-sourced reusable components, facilitating educational tools, interactive fiction, and entertainment platforms.

Implemented task orchestration, content validation, and AI-driven creativity scoring, enhancing content quality and coherence across generated outputs.

Multi-Agent Workflow Engine (AI Orchestration) | 2025 – Present

Engineered a scalable multi-agent orchestration framework enabling parallel and hierarchical execution of AI agents for complex tasks.

Designed dynamic workflow DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs) for automated data ingestion, cleaning, transformation, analysis, and report generation, reducing manual orchestration efforts by 40%.

Implemented inter-agent communication protocols and task dependencies to ensure robust coordination and error handling across AI agents.

Integrated LLM-driven agents for intelligent decision-making, data summarization, and report generation, improving overall pipeline efficiency.

Developed the system as a pluggable, open-source layer that can be seamlessly integrated into LLM-based applications for end-to-end AI workflows.

Optimized execution for concurrency and resource utilization, enabling faster turnaround for multi-step workflows.

Documented APIs, usage patterns, and examples for community adoption, contributing to open-source AI orchestration ecosystem.

📊 Project Highlights

Oracle Fusion: Developed enterprise UI and middleware with Java, Oracle ADF, and REST APIs, boosting user adoption in financial and HR modules.

Apple iReporter: Optimized real-time analytics pipelines with Spark, Kafka, and ElasticSearch, cutting data latency from 10s to <2s.

Secure OTA Updates: Designed Spring Boot microservices for automotive firmware updates with AES encryption and token-based auth, ensuring zero-downtime rollouts.

AI/ML Research: Prototyped RAG, multi-agent systems, and LLM orchestration, including voice-driven interfaces and automated workflows.

🎓 Education
M.Sc. in Information Technology

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Oracle India Pvt Ltd, Bangalore | Aug 2021 – Mar 2025
Architected and optimized Oracle Fusion Applications using Oracle ADF and Spring Boot, ensuring modularity and maintainability.
Designed and deployed microservices architectures with REST APIs, enabling seamless integration across enterprise systems.
Implemented performance tuning strategies (caching, connection pooling, async processing) that reduced latency and improved throughput.
Enhanced scalability and resilience with load balancing, horizontal scaling, and fault-tolerant service design.
Led middleware integration and backend processing, resolving complex distributed system issues under tight SLAs.
Improved monitoring & observability with logging, tracing, and metrics, enabling proactive issue detection and faster root-cause analysis.
Senior Software Engineer
Sirius Embedded Software Pvt Ltd, Bangalore | Oct 2018 – Aug 2021
Led migration from monolithic to microservices architecture, driving design decisions and mentoring engineers.
Developed cloud-based microservices for secure OTA (Over-the-Air) automotive updates using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and open-source Java frameworks.
Integrated authentication & authorization with Okta and JWT for secure access management.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes) for automated build, test, and deployment.
Built real-time data pipelines with PostgreSQL + AWS Lambda, reducing processing latency by 40%.
Delivered scalable, fault-tolerant solutions in cross-functional Agile teams, improving time-to-market.
Software Consultant
Infogain Corporation, Bangalore | Nov 2014 – Aug 2018
Engineered big data pipelines using Hadoop, MapReduce, and Hive to process terabytes of enterprise data.
Designed and implemented ETL workflows (data ingestion, cleansing, transformation) from diverse sources like Oracle DB and APIs.
Automated data quality checks to ensure consistency and reliability for downstream consumption.
Performed EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) with statistical methods and visualization to uncover trends and anomalies.
Created probabilistic algorithms for efficient data retrieval, improving query performance.
Led a team in delivering high-performance enterprise solutions, optimizing scalability and maintainability.
Previous Roles (2007 – 2014)
Held various development and leadership roles across network management and cloud-based systems.
Delivered scalable, enterprise-grade applications with significant client impact.
💡 Projects & Open Source
Customer Service Microservice (CRM Application) | Jan 2023 – Mar 2025
Designed and developed the Customer Service microservice as part of a large-scale CRM microservices architecture (Accounts, Leads, Opportunities, Campaigns, Notifications, Analytics).
Implemented RESTful APIs for service request creation, SLA tracking, and escalations; integrated with Accounts and Notification services for seamless customer experience.
Architected and deployed an AI-powered chatbot using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with Oracle-developed LLM to automate customer support:
Configured retriever pipeline with vector database for FAQs, historical tickets, and policy documents.
Instructed the LLM to respond only to business-context queries, with a refinement layer to validate and reformat responses before showing to users.
Integrated with Customer Service APIs to auto-create/update tickets when bot confidence was low or escalation was required.
Ensured data security and compliance by implementing JWT authentication, anonymizing sensitive customer data, and encrypting data at rest.
Optimized performance by caching frequent queries, reducing average bot response time by 50%.
Implemented logging, monitoring (ELK, Prometheus), and fallback mechanisms to ensure system reliability and traceability.
Impact: Automated ~40% of repetitive queries, reduced average response time by 60%, and freed agents to focus on complex issues — significantly improving customer satisfaction and efficiency.
Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Oracle LLM, RAG, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate/Oracle equivalent), JWT, Docker, ELK Stack, Prometheus.
Voice-Powered RAG Agent System | 2025 – Present
Designed and implemented a voice-interactive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system integrating Whisper ASR, LangChain, and vector databases (FAISS/Chroma) for real-time query resolution.
Enabled conversational search across enterprise and research documents, providing users with instant, context-aware responses and improving information accessibility.
Built a pipeline for audio-to-text processing, semantic search, and LLM-driven answer generation, optimizing for low-latency real-time interaction.
Developed mechanisms for query contextualization, retrieval ranking, and result summarization, enhancing accuracy and user experience.
Designed the system to be scalable and modular, allowing seamless integration with other enterprise knowledge management systems.
Creative Writing Agents (LLM Orchestration) | 2025 – Present
Developed autonomous writing agents orchestrated via LangGraph, capable of generating stories, scripts, and structured content with minimal human supervision.
Designed modular pipelines for character-driven storytelling, enabling dynamic plot generation, dialogue creation, and thematic consistency.
Open-sourced reusable components, facilitating educational tools, interactive fiction, and entertainment platforms.
Implemented task orchestration, content validation, and AI-driven creativity scoring, enhancing content quality and coherence across generated outputs.
Multi-Agent Workflow Engine (AI Orchestration) | 2025 – Present
Engineered a scalable multi-agent orchestration framework enabling parallel and hierarchical execution of AI agents for complex tasks.
Designed dynamic workflow DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs) for automated data ingestion, cleaning, transformation, analysis, and report generation, reducing manual orchestration efforts by 40%.
Implemented inter-agent communication protocols and task dependencies to ensure robust coordination and error handling across AI agents.
Integrated LLM-driven agents for intelligent decision-making, data summarization, and report generation, improving overall pipeline efficiency.
Developed the system as a pluggable, open-source layer that can be seamlessly integrated into LLM-based applications for end-to-end AI workflows.
Optimized execution for concurrency and resource utilization, enabling faster turnaround for multi-step workflows.
Documented APIs, usage patterns, and examples for community adoption, contributing to open-source AI orchestration ecosystem.
📊 Project Highlights
Oracle Fusion: Developed enterprise UI and middleware with Java, Oracle ADF, and REST APIs, boosting user adoption in financial and HR modules.
Apple iReporter: Optimized real-time analytics pipelines with Spark, Kafka, and ElasticSearch, cutting data latency from 10s to <2s.
Secure OTA Updates: Designed Spring Boot microservices for automotive firmware updates with AES encryption and token-based auth, ensuring zero-downtime rollouts.
AI/ML Research: Prototyped RAG, multi-agent systems, and LLM orchestration, including voice-driven interfaces and automated workflows.
🎓 Education
M.Sc. in Information Technology
